modes.answer_text: This article titled "Gravitational waves in the presence of an electromagnetic field.  II" by Cahen, M., Leroy, J., presents a study on gravitational waves and their interaction with electromagnetic fields. The main topic is gravity wave theory, which includes Einstein-Maxwell equations as part of its derivation. This research was conducted at NASA's Legacy CDMS (CDMS) center. It was first published in Belgium by the Academie Royale de Belgique on 1965 and last distributed to the public on 2019. The document type is a reprint, with no DOI or report numbers listed. For more information, please visit https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19660058018.
